plan_changes.previous_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, share results, take bottle 2, help move Sam to dry spot and ensure two get to shoreline.
plan_changes.current_plan: Share result, then assess Sam's leg, get two people to shoreline (Sam if he can be moved), and the rest decide on shelter/outside.
plan_changes.reason: The others plan around shelter with bottles; they must know the water is bad so they prioritize the shoreline pickup.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Elizabeth kneels beside the bottle on the sand, opens her first-aid kit and draws out a test strip, holding it to the water.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Before we carry these anywhere, let me test the water. Shelter only helps if it's clean.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth holds up the test strip and shakes her head, looking at Sam and Welsy.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Take a bottle, have Elizabeth take the other. Then help Sam to the dry spot and build the shelter. Sort out who goes to the shoreline for the boat.
plan_changes.current_plan: Accept Elizabeth's finding. Get Sam to the shoreline, decide with Elizabeth who takes the second boat place, then commit. Shelter is pointless without clean water.
plan_changes.reason: Elizabeth reports both bottles contaminated, so shelter is deadly and the boat is the only sure survival. Sam needs help moving.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Elizabeth holds up the test strip and shakes her head, looking at Sam and Welsy.
plan_changes.prompt_line: The water's contaminated, both bottles. Shelter without clean water won't save anyone. Two of us must make the shoreline for the boat.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Welsy sets a steadying arm under Sam's shoulder and nods to Elizabeth, coiling the rope at her hip.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Get Sam to shoreline, Elizabeth follows, settle second boat place, commit.
plan_changes.current_plan: Offer the second place to Elizabeth and stay behind. Remind everyone of the promise to send help back. Keep bottle 1 in case.
plan_changes.reason: Sam is committed and Elizabeth is here. The nurse should go with the injured man. I trust her test, and I can cope outside better than they can.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Elizabeth shoulders the first-aid kit and hurries along the sand toward the shoreline through the driving rain.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Coming down now. Sam's set. Welsy, let's settle the second place together.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Welsy steps beside Elizabeth and nods toward the boat landing, rope coiled over her shoulder, bottle still in hand.
